text: Jackson "Action" Asiku, born on 21 October 1978, is a Ugandan-Australian amateur flyweight and professional feather/super featherweight boxer. As an amateur, he represented Uganda at the 1998 Commonwealth Games in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, where he won a bronze medal, losing to Richard Sunee of Mauritius, the eventual gold medalist. In 1999, he earned a bronze medal in the flyweight category at the All-Africa Games in Johannesburg, South Africa, losing to Nacer Keddam of Algeria, who won silver. In 2000, he competed in the Summer Olympics in Sydney, Australia, where he lost to Arlan Lerio of the Philippines. Throughout his amateur career, he competed in the flyweight division. Professionally, Asiku won the Australian featherweight title, the World Boxing Organization (WBO) Asia Pacific featherweight title, the African Boxing Union (ABU) featherweight title, the International Boxing Federation (IBF) Australasian featherweight title, the International Boxing Organization (IBO) featherweight title, and the Commonwealth featherweight title. He also challenged for the International Boxing Federation (IBF) Pan Pacific featherweight title against Fahprakorb Rakkiatgym. His professional weight range spanned from 123+1⁄2 lb (56.0 kg; 8 st 11.5 lb), featherweight, to 129+3⁄4 lb (58.9 kg; 9 st 3.8 lb), super featherweight.
